description.description: A description of the configuration. Maximum length of 256 characters.

id.description: The unique system identifier for this specific Custom URL Category resource.

name.description: A unique, user-friendly name for this configuration. Required field. Maximum length of 128 characters.

tags.description: An array (list) of key-value tags or labels for organizational purposes. Allows a maximum of 10 unique tags.

url_server_fqdns.description: An array of Fully Qualified Domain Names (FQDNs) for the URL filtering cloud service/servers. These FQDNs define the addresses the security devices (like SD-WAN appliances) use to query the URL filtering database.
